name: fanoutfuse
description: Stops runaway subagent fan-out in Claude Code: refuses new Agent, Workflow and ultracode spawns past a limit or a 5-hour quota burn rate, and stops agents already running.

total_spawns_trip.title: Total spawns: trip
total_spawns_trip.description: Refuse new subagents once a session has started this many. 0 turns the rule off.

spawn_rate_trip.title: Spawns per minute: trip
spawn_rate_trip.description: Trip when this many subagents start within 60 seconds. 0 turns the rule off.

spawn_burst_trip.title: Spawns per 10 seconds: trip
spawn_burst_trip.description: Trip when this many subagents start within 10 seconds. A workflow runs up to 16 at once. 0 turns the rule off.

running_concurrent_trip.title: Running at once: trip
running_concurrent_trip.description: Trip when this many subagents are running at the same time. 0 turns the rule off.

max_depth_trip.title: Nesting depth: trip
max_depth_trip.description: Trip when Agent-tool subagents nest this deep. 0 turns the rule off.

quota_burn_trip.title: 5-hour quota burn: trip (points per minute)
quota_burn_trip.description: Trip when the 5-hour usage window climbs this many percentage points per minute. 0 turns the rule off.

quota_burn_warn.title: 5-hour quota burn: warn (points per minute)
quota_burn_warn.description: Warn at this burn rate. 0 turns the warning off.

quota_window_min.title: Quota burn window (minutes)
quota_window_min.description: How many minutes of 5-hour readings the burn rate is measured over.

quota_used_trip.title: 5-hour quota used: trip (percent)
quota_used_trip.description: Trip when the 5-hour window reaches this percent used. 0 turns the rule off.

stop_running.title: Stop running agents on trip
stop_running.description: On a trip, stop subagents and workflows that are already running (TaskStop).

abort_turn.title: Abort the current turn on trip
abort_turn.description: On a trip, also interrupt the main conversation's current turn.
